facts: p11-3a:Show that Newton’s second law leads to F = ma for a body of constant mass.
text: Show that Newton’s second law leads to F = ma for a body of constant mass.

points.text: The law says that force is proportional to the rate of change of momentum.
So F = k d(mv)/dt.
With constant mass, this is k m dv/dt = kma.
Choosing units so that k = 1 gives F = ma.
